payload.summary: The corporate performance report for the first quarter of 2025/26, taken to Cabinet on 10 September 2025. Every indicator carries a target and an intervention level the council sets itself, with the actual beside them. Of 19 indicators reported that quarter, 13 were green, 2 amber and 4 red. The numbers themselves are in Appendix A as screenshots of a dashboard rather than as text.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
